```artifact
Feature: Controller and GUI Alarm Functionality

  Scenario: Controller reports proximal tube connection status
    Given the proximal tube is connected
    When the controller checks the proximal tube connection
    Then the controller reports that the proximal tube is connected

  Scenario: Controller reports proximal tube disconnection status
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the controller checks the proximal tube connection
    Then the controller reports that the proximal tube is disconnected

  Scenario: GUI activates proximal tube disconnect alarm when tube is disconnected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the GUI checks the proximal tube connection status
    Then the GUI activates the "proximal tube disconnect" alarm

  Scenario: GUI deactivates proximal tube disconnect alarm when tube is reconnected
    Given the proximal tube disconnect alarm is active
    And the proximal tube is reconnected
    When the GUI checks the proximal tube connection status
    Then the GUI deactivates the "proximal tube disconnect" alarm

  Scenario: Proximal tube disconnect alarm has medium priority
    Given the proximal tube disconnect alarm is active
    When the GUI retrieves the priority of the "proximal tube disconnect" alarm
    Then the priority of the "proximal tube disconnect" alarm is medium

  Scenario Outline: GUI detects obstruction based on VTI value
    Given the VTI value is <VTI>
    When the GUI checks for obstruction
    Then the GUI <obstruction_status>
    Examples:
      | VTI  | obstruction_status       |
      | 99   | detects obstruction      |
      | 100  | does not detect obstruction |
      | 101  | does not detect obstruction |

  Scenario: GUI activates obstruction alarm when obstruction is detected
    Given the VTI value is 99
    When the GUI checks for obstruction
    Then the GUI activates the "obstruction" alarm

  Scenario: GUI deactivates obstruction alarm when obstruction is not detected
    Given the VTI value is 101
    And the obstruction alarm is active
    When the GUI checks for obstruction
    Then the GUI deactivates the "obstruction" alarm

  Scenario: Obstruction alarm has high priority
    Given the obstruction alarm is active
    When the GUI retrieves the priority of the "obstruction" alarm
    Then the priority of the "obstruction" alarm is high

  Scenario Outline: GUI computes amount of leakage based on sensor readings
    Given the sensor readings are <sensor_readings>
    When the GUI computes the amount of leakage
    Then the computed leakage is <leakage>
    Examples:
      | sensor_readings | leakage |
      | 0.5, 0.5, 0.5   | 1.5     |
      | 1.0, 1.0, 1.0   | 3.0     |
      | 0.0, 0.0, 0.0   | 0.0     |

  Scenario Outline: GUI handles invalid VTI values
    Given the VTI value is <VTI>
    When the GUI checks for obstruction
    Then the GUI <response>
    Examples:
      | VTI  | response                    |
      | -1   | logs an error               |
      | abc  | logs an error               |
```
